headline: Indian Government Bonds Edge Higher on Softer Oil and Stable US Yields
summary: Indian government bonds edged up with the benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield at 7.1871%, supported by softer oil prices and steady US Treasuries ahead of the central bank policy decision.
why: Sovereign debt yields in India respond to domestic inflation expectations, global crude oil benchmarks, and Reserve Bank of India policy expectations.

impacts.name: India 10-Year Bond Yield
impacts.why: Softening oil prices and stable global yields ease pressure on domestic debt yields.
